$description: Type roles: the 22 text styles of Figma's `Unicron Type/` folder (Unicron 2.0, read 2026-11-24), the eight retired ones (Unicron Type/Retired/, kept for parts not yet restyled) and mono-row (waiting on its Figma style), one set for every app and both grounds. One sans (Geist) for every interface role; mono only for code. Each is a DTCG typography composite: the family is a reference to a tier 1 font; weight, size, line height and letter spacing are Figma's numbers, in Figma's units (px, and em for the percent). The build emits five variables per role: --type-<role>-family, -weight, -size, -leading and -tracking. @unicron/ui's stylesheet turns each role into one `type-<role>` utility. A change here is a change in Figma first (scripts/figma-parity.mjs holds the two together).

display.$description: Retired in Figma (Unicron Type/Retired/, 2026-11-23); kept for parts not yet restyled, removed in 2.1. Figma Unicron Type/display: Geist Bold 72/68, -4%. Empty-state hero, big moments. The line box is shorter than the type on purpose (72/68).

display-compact.$description: Retired in Figma (Unicron Type/Retired/, 2026-11-23); kept for parts not yet restyled, removed in 2.1. Figma Unicron Type/display/compact: Geist Bold 48/48, -3%. The compact display size.

title.$description: Figma Unicron Type/title: Geist SemiBold 20/28. Page titles in an app: 20/28.

lead.$description: Figma Unicron Type/lead: Geist Medium 24/32, -1%. The Home greeting and a large lead line.

subtitle.$description: Figma Unicron Type/subtitle: Geist SemiBold 15/20. Panel and section headings.

body.$description: Figma Unicron Type/body: Geist Regular 15/24. Chat prose and long text: 15/24.

body-strong.$description: Figma Unicron Type/body/strong: Geist Medium 16/24. Emphasised long text.

response.$description: Figma Unicron Type/response: Geist Regular 15/24. An agent's reply.

ui.$description: Figma Unicron Type/ui: Geist Regular 13/20. Interface text: sidebar rows, panel rows, meta lines that read as text.

ui-emphasis.$description: Figma Unicron Type/ui/emphasis: Geist Medium 13/20. Button labels and the selected row.

label.$description: Figma Unicron Type/label: Geist Medium 13/20. A field's label.

caption.$description: Figma Unicron Type/caption: Geist Regular 12/16. Small support text.

overline.$description: Figma Unicron Type/overline: Geist SemiBold 11/16, +4%. Small all-caps section labels, in the sans. The only role with a case: upper. Type the text in normal case.

folio.$description: Figma Unicron Type/folio: Geist Medium 12/16. A small emphasised number or count.

meta.$description: Figma Unicron Type/meta: Geist Regular 12/16. Time, engine and place lines.

mono-row.$description: Geist Mono Regular 13/20, as typed: the mono line of a row that holds a person's own words (a username, a site), at the 13px a popup keeps reading text at (Lockdown 4, 1.1). The meta role is the same at 12px. Not in Figma yet: Sean adds `Unicron Type/mono/row`.

code-inline.$description: Figma Unicron Type/code/inline: Geist Mono Regular 13/20. Code, paths and ids inside text.

code-display.$description: Retired in Figma (Unicron Type/Retired/, 2026-11-23); kept for parts not yet restyled, removed in 2.1. Figma Unicron Type/code/display: Geist Mono Medium 36/40, +12%. Large codes, for example a one-time code.

number-hero.$description: Retired in Figma (Unicron Type/Retired/, 2026-11-23); kept for parts not yet restyled, removed in 2.1. Figma Unicron Type/number/hero: Geist Bold 168/148, -5%. Hero numbers. The line box is shorter than the type on purpose (168/148).

number-metric.$description: Retired in Figma (Unicron Type/Retired/, 2026-11-23); kept for parts not yet restyled, removed in 2.1. Figma Unicron Type/number/metric: Geist Bold 44/44, -2%. Metric values.

number-index.$description: Retired in Figma (Unicron Type/Retired/, 2026-11-23); kept for parts not yet restyled, removed in 2.1. Figma Unicron Type/number/index: Geist Bold 28/32, -2%. Index numerals (item 03, task 014).

number-count.$description: Figma Unicron Type/number/count: Geist SemiBold 24/32, -0.5%. A large count in a tile.

brand-wordmark.$description: Retired in Figma (Unicron Type/Retired/, 2026-11-23); kept for parts not yet restyled, removed in 2.1. Figma Unicron Type/brand/wordmark: Geist Bold 13/16, +12%. The app wordmark in the App Lockup.

icon-glyph.$description: Retired in Figma (Unicron Type/Retired/, 2026-11-23); kept for parts not yet restyled, removed in 2.1. Figma Unicron Type/icon/glyph: Geist Regular 32/32. The letter in a placeholder mark. No component on the Figma components page uses it.

control.$description: Figma Unicron Type/control: Geist Regular 14/20. Text inside fields and controls: 14/20.

large-title.$description: Figma Unicron Type/large-title: Geist Bold 28/34, -1.4286%. The phone's large title: 28/34.

tab-label.$description: Figma Unicron Type/tab-label: Geist Medium 10/12. Phone tab bar labels: 10/12.

tab-label-selected.$description: Figma Unicron Type/tab-label/selected: Geist SemiBold 10/12. The selected phone tab label.

control-strong.$description: Figma Unicron Type/control/strong: Geist SemiBold 14/20. A strong control label.

code-reveal.$description: Figma Unicron Type/code/reveal: Geist Mono Regular 15/24, +2%. A revealed secret or code, spaced for reading aloud.

crumb.$description: Figma Unicron Type/crumb: Geist Medium 15/20. The title row's breadcrumb and the Settings location label: 15/20.
